title: Harborline Domain Credit on Certificate Renewal
content:
**Domain team credit note: SSL/TLS Certificates.** A support renewal is a one-year renewal that Harborline support books during a conversation. A support renewal of an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription carries a Harborline domain credit when the certificate's domain is registered with Harborline under Domain Registrations and that registration is in active status. The credit is subtracted from the support renewal amount. Its size follows the nameservers recorded on that registration.

1. **Active registration on Harborline DNS.** The credit is USD 3.00. Domain validation there completes automatically.
2. **Active registration on external nameservers.** The credit is USD 1.50.
3. **Any other case.** No Harborline domain credit applies. This covers a domain registered elsewhere, a certificate linked to no Harborline registration, and a Harborline registration that is not in active status.

### Condition and result

| Linked Harborline registration | Registration status | Nameservers | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | active | Harborline DNS | USD 3.00 |
| yes | active | external | USD 1.50 |
| yes | not active | either | none |
| no | — | — | none |

The registration that counts is the one the certificate subscription names as its domain. Another registration held by the customer does not count.

*Hypothetical example:* a certificate covers ledger.example. Its Domain Registrations record is active with external nameservers, so a support renewal carries USD 1.50. If the nameservers on that registration were Harborline DNS at the time of the renewal, the credit would be USD 3.00 instead.
